entries.zh: 十；上午十时，日尚未到正午
entries.en: ten; ten o'clock in the morning, before noon
entries.notes: R 栏 xīt fán zūn 与 H『日小午』不能对应，L 末『no ngōn』未详，仅可定『上午十时、日未及午』。

entries.en: ten; ten to eleven o'clock at night
entries.notes: L 明言夜间十至十一时，H 栏『雞(鳴?)』与此时刻不合，疑原稿时称错置。

entries.en: ten thousand years; an age, eternity

entries.zh: 征收什一税；抽取（十分之一）
entries.en: to tithe; to levy a tenth, to extract
difference; to differ; error, to err
entries.notes: M 栏附『errar』，与『差錯』(chha-chhò) 音合，故兼收差错一义。

entries.en: kind, class, sort (difference of things)
difference, distinction; to distinguish

entries.zh: 等级，品级（官阶高下之别）
entries.en: rank, grade (difference of dignity or degree)
entries.notes: H『給』当为『級』之借字（kip），故释作官阶品级之别。

entries.en: different, distinct; difference in manner
different; difference (in things)
entries.notes: M 栏三音节『ĭ̃ ū̃ iāng』未能对应，释义从 H『異』与 R『ī』。

entries.en: contradiction, inconsistency; to be at variance
entries.notes: H 首字残疑（矛/茅），M 栏『maù ēn／Bāī ēn』未详；R『môn tūn』可证为『矛盾』。

entries.en: various kinds; each different
entries.notes: R 栏首有『pìng)』残迹，疑为上行窜入。

entries.en: deviation; to go off course, to be off
about the same; little difference
entries.notes: L『puca』当为『poca』（差别小），与『差不多』正合。

entries.en: distinction, to distinguish
different in appearance; unusual
entries.notes: M/R 音写与第 12 条『各樣』重复，疑原稿串行；释义从 H『異樣』。

entries.en: abnormal, unusual
entries.notes: L 拼作『Diference』，为 Diferencia 之讹；H/R 均主『異常』。

entries.zh: 你们各人各不相同；各别
entries.en: different, each one of you; individually distinct
entries.notes: H 首字残疑（苦/茍），M『fèng fèng』未能确解，义仅据 L 与 H 末『各別』推定。

entries.zh: 当道，挡路；歧路（不正之道）
entries.en: to block the way; a different path, waywardness
entries.notes: L 第二义『immoralidad』与『當路』难合，疑为旁注窜入；释义取『当道、挡路』本义。

entries.zh: 形貌太野，衣着与他人不同
entries.en: differing from the others in dress; too rustic in appearance
entries.notes: H『太野形』指形貌粗野，与 L『en traje』（衣着）相合。
